'''Nizzle''' is a [[goblin]] food vendor located in [[Booty Bay]] in the [[Stranglethorn Vale]]. He sells rare imports from [[Kezan]] to well-off customers.

==Quests==
* {{questlong|Neutral|60|Kezan Fruitcake Imports}} {{queststartfinish}}

==Quotes==
;Gossip
Hey there bud, I'm Nizzle, and I make a living importing goods all the way from Kezan. If you're looking for the good stuff, you've found the right spot.
